subject: Finishes that help a workspace feel calm
hook: Will a matt desk show every mark?
fb:
A question we get asked a lot when people choose matt finishes for a home office: will it show every mark?

Honest answer: matt and super matt surfaces are easy to keep clean, but they need the right cloth. A soft, damp microfibre with a drop of washing-up liquid, then a dry wipe, deals with everyday marks. Skip abrasive pads, furniture polish and solvent sprays, which can leave shiny patches on a matt surface.

Colour makes a difference too. Charcoal and black show dust sooner than oak-effect or white. If you'd prefer less wiping, ask to see a few samples side by side at your consultation.
